evals.prompt: Refactor this repo's mise tasks: move complex TOML tasks into .mise/tasks and fix shadowed install/uninstall names.
evals.expected_output: Agent migrates non-one-liners to file tasks, renames install/uninstall into a domain task with subcommands, adds usage help, bats, shellcheck tooling, confirms before deleting/renaming public entrypoints.

evals.prompt: We have skills-auth, skills-install, skills-update as separate mise tasks — collapse them.
evals.expected_output: Agent creates one skills file task with auth|install|update cmds and usage help, removes or redirects the hyphenated siblings, updates callers/docs, adds bats.

evals.prompt: Fix mise task quality: add missing bats/shellcheck and pull dangerous task-only scripts out of scripts/.
evals.expected_output: Agent relocates task-private scripts under .mise/tasks, pins shellcheck/bats, adds tests/mise-tasks coverage and a non-colliding ci lint/test entrypoint as needed.
